findings.finding: ZeroInitStructsHolder::getInstance uses a static weak instance; multiple concurrent ov::Core objects may share one underlying Level Zero context.
Private provider header inspected for exact shared queue configuration; this is not a stable public API guarantee.

inferences: Separate Core objects alone do not establish distinct NPU contexts. Queue sharing can be tested independently without assuming context ownership must change.
No hardware queue capacity or cause of earlier device loss is established.
